title: Cancel a turn
description: Section 8. ACP session/cancel from an attached client stops the turn; it ends with stopReason cancelled.

steps.note: Open a connection to the host (through its relay, or on the LAN).
The first frame is host/hello: the versions this client speaks and the device credential from pairing.
The host picks 0.1 and says which device this connection is. `info` is the same object host/info returns.
ACP starts every agent channel with initialize. The host answers it itself with the agent's capabilities; the client's are not passed on.
ACP protocol version 1. No sign-in methods: the agent runs under its owner's own sign-in on the host.
ACP session/new, unchanged. cwd is the agent's folder from host/agents; a remote client can't pick another folder or add MCP servers that run commands.
The agent's own session id and modes. This connection is now attached to the session.
The fake agent works on `wait` until it is cancelled.
The agent says it is working.
The prompt ends with ACP's cancelled stop reason, not an error.
Everyone attached sees the turn end.
